eventDetail.scope: With the theme “Converging Technologies for Sustainable Innovation,” the conference provides an interdisciplinary forum for presenting original research and applied innovations across communications, networking, computing and intelligent systems, signal processing, electronic and embedded design, cyber-physical and secure systems, sustainable energy and smart grids, advanced materials and emerging devices, and robotics, control, and automation. The scope emphasizes technologies and solutions that enable secure, energy-efficient, and scalable systems with meaningful societal and industrial impact.
